subject: Optimize toolkit pricing and technical packaging for NimbleHealth pilot
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <claire@nimblehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: Optimize toolkit pricing and recommendations

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the chat last week. We're evaluating Redwood's Optimize toolkit to reduce token spend and get consistent latency for our clinical triage assistant. Before we schedule a technical deep-dive, could you share: 1) a short commercial framework (commit bands / pilot options / credits), 2) high-level quantization guidance (recommended model variants and expected perf/cost delta), and 3) any caching/batching patterns that reliably move the needle on cost for ~2k concurrent users with ~512 token responses (50% of requests are similar prefixes).

Procurement is targeting a decision by the second week of May — we'll need a one-page commercial to kick off legal. Also looping in our procurement manager Tom (cc'ed).

Cheers,
Claire O'Neill
Head of Platform, NimbleHealth
claire@nimblehealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Optimize toolkit pricing and recommendations

Hi Claire — great to hear. Quick ballpark and suggested next steps below; attaching a short pricing scenarios PDF and an example spreadsheet. Happy to jump on a 30-min call this week to align.

Commercial framework (ballpark):
- Pilot (6 months): $25k Optimize credits + usage overage at list rates. 1 TB of KV cache included for pilot.
- 12-month committed band: $120k/year Optimize credits + 10% volume discount; include 3 months of burst credits for onboarding.
- 24-month: $210k/year with 15% discount and additional support hours.

Technical recommendations (summary):
- Quantization: start with a Q4_INT8 profile for your 13B family (balance of perf and quality). Expect ~2.5-3x throughput improvement for generation with <1% top-line quality regression on conversation prompts.
- Batching: continuous batching with 8-16 token-level batch size for steady-state; prefer adaptive burst batching for spikes.
- Caching/prefix reuse: implement prefix KV caching on common templates (50% of requests are similar => potential 20-30% token savings).
- Fall-back plan: keep a higher-precision variant pinned for edge cases (e.g., MPTx/14B fp16).

Next steps:
1) I can share a one-pager commercial and SOW stub.
2) Dylan can run a quick perf/quality estimate if you can share a small set of representative prompts (10-20).
3) If procurement wants pricing bands, we can sketch commit vs pilot tradeoffs.

Attaching: redwood_optimize_pricing_v1.pdf, nimble_pricing_scenario_v1.xlsx

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference

--

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Initial: Optimize toolkit pricing and recommendations

Laura/Dylan — Claire asked for a concise one-pager for procurement and quant/batching guidance. Deal thoughts below; please weigh in on technical numbers and concession strategy.

Deal context: NimbleHealth wants good cost reduction quickly, procurement deadline ~2027-05-10. Potential ARR if full rollout ~ $600k/yr. Pilot preferred approach.

Proposed commercial moves (my thinking):
- Offer 6-month pilot: $22k Optimize credits + 2 months of burst credits + 1 TB KV cache. If pilot successful, convert with a 12-month commit at $110k/yr with an early-conversion credit equal to remaining pilot credits.
- Alternatively, 12-month upfront commit gets 12% discount; 24-month gets 18%.

Technical asks for Dylan:
- Validate expected throughput uplift for Q4_INT8 on their likely model (they mentioned a 13B family). If Q4_INT8 gives 2.5x token/sec, we can justify the pilot as low-cost proof.
- Estimate token-savings from prefix caching given 50% templated traffic.

Concessions guidance: keep discounting inside commit band; try not to give single-digit list reductions outside credit structure. Offer an onboarding credit to offset early evaluation risk.

Attaching internal tech note: technical_note_quant.md (quick quant tradeoffs)

-J

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal: NimbleHealth pilot (commercial + technical summary)

Hi Claire / Tom — thanks again for the time. Per Jordan's note, here is a short proposal for a pilot and the commercial bands to share with procurement. Happy to adjust if you have constraints.

1) Pilot option (recommended first step) - 6 months - • Optimize credits: $22,000 included (applies to optimizer recommendations, caching configuration, and trial quant profiles)
- • Onboarding: 2 months of burst credits to absorb initial traffic spikes
- • KV cache: 1 TB included; extra cache billed at $0.12/GB-month
- • Support: Standard (email + 8x5)
- Expected outcomes: ~20-35% token cost reduction from combined batching/caching + quantization; latency SLO maintained for 95th pct.

2) Convert/Commit options
- 12-month: $110,000/year (12% discount vs list) + 3 months of additional credits at sign
- 24-month: $200,000/year (18% discount) + prioritized capacity scheduling windows for onboarding

3) Technical summary (for your infra and SRE teams)
- Quant profile: start with Q4_INT8 on the 13B variant. For prompts that are highly safety-sensitive, we recommend routing to fp16 variant.
- Expected perf: ~2.0-3.0x throughput improvement on GPU inference with minor quality delta on chat prompts; we'll run a focused eval on your 20 prompt set to measure exact delta.
- Batching: use adaptive batching with max latency SLO of 250ms; target average micro-batch size 8-12 tokens for your traffic shape.
- Caching: prefix dedupe + KV lifetime of 10-30 minutes for conversational templates; we estimate ~20% token savings if 50% of traffic is templated.

Procurement items we can include in the one-pager:
- SOW stub: https://drive.redwood.com/s/12345/SOW_nimble_v1.docx- SOC 2 type II report (we can share read-only link upon NDA)

If this looks good, we can provide an official quote and an SOW. Suggested call to finalize: Fri Apr 23 9:30am PT (30m).

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
